leadText:
Volume 56 is the 56th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the second volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's English translation, this volume is published as volume one of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: X•Y", which also includes the four chapters that were left out of the previous volume in the English release.
plainText:
Volume 56 is the 56th volume of the Pokémon Adventures manga. It is the second volume in the . It is authored by Hidenori Kusaka and illustrated by Satoshi Yamamoto.

In VIZ Media's English translation, this volume is published as volume one of a separately numbered series, "Pokémon Adventures: X•Y", which also includes the four chapters that were left out of the previous volume in the English release.

==Blurb==
Now it’s up to X to use the skills that made him champion to defeat the threat looming over Vaniville Town.

Can the reclusive X and the determined Y help their friends ward off two Legendary Pokémon and the mysterious Team Flare?!
